==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I achieved lucidity utilizing the self induced sleep paralysis method. I commanded my ghostly UFO to collect the zombies with its tractor beam. (My ghostly UFO has an ethereal green glow to it and is shaped like a saucer.) (The zombies are elven zombies being pulled from the Elven Village. The Elven Village is made up of huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees. ) (This dream is a part of a larger dream narrative that has been ongoing since 06/11/2025.)
It released the zombies in space where they can feast on Boltzmann's brains. (I stayed in the Elven Village, while my ghostly UFO completed the mission out in space.)
I turned over the Death Witch to the Elven Guard, and became a deputy. (The badge for the guard resembles a wooden circle, with a silver trim, marked with a green spiral.) (The Death Witch resembles a woman with pale skin, straight black hair, red eyes, long tattered black robes, a belt made of skulls.)
